arguments.sql:
SELECT r.date, r.text, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(DISTINCT r.uuid) AS printings
FROM main.rulings AS r
JOIN main.cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
GROUP BY r.date, r.text
ORDER BY r.date DESC
LIMIT 10;

FROM main.rulings AS r

GROUP BY r.date
ORDER BY r.date DESC
LIMIT 1;
